name: request_human_handover
description: Requests a callback from a person on the HAQ team. Use when the caller asks for a human or person, says stop but wants help, mentions eviction, hardship or distress, has an active Rental Disputes Center case, asks HAQ to file something, or after two failed read backs. Returns a reference and a callback message to read to the caller.

reason.description: Short reason for the handover, for example: caller asked for a person; eviction; distress; active RDC case; asked to file; two failed read backs.

summary.description: Two or three sentence summary of the conversation so far, with the confirmed facts. Never include passwords, Emirates ID, UAE PASS codes or bank details.

language.description: Language the caller is using: en or ar.

callback_consent.description: True only if the caller clearly agreed to be called back.
